description: Use it only after the person said in this conversation that they want to cancel this booking or enquiry: ask them before you call it, and pass their reason in their words. It needs the person signed in. An enquiry, a quote or a hold with no money on it is cancelled. A confirmed or paid booking is not: status requested means the desk has a cancellation request, which is neither a cancellation nor a refund, so tell them that.

ifStatus.description: Cancel only if it is still in this status, as get_booking_status answered it.

name: cancel_booking

nextStep.description: What happens now, in words to tell the person.

status.description: cancelled: done; requested: the desk has a request, which is neither a cancellation nor a refund; already_cancelled: nothing to do.
